notes.title: QoL Updates
notes.notes: Fixed keyboard control problems for single player mode and added better statistic displays.

notes.title: Second Day Updates
notes.notes: [p]After huge insistence from the fans, I updated the control scheme for the single player mode: Now directional buttons are also supported! No more only WASD for controls.[/p][p][/p][p]Also added a GUI element to see how many lives the user has left -for only the first player for now-, and also added GUI elements that show the current stats for the upgrades.[/p]
